rule: Every figure here is a published list price or statistic, read from its primary page on the date given. The cost case (src/cost.mjs) multiplies them by the buyer's own numbers; the page renders them from this file, never typed. The wage, CPI, electricity and exchange rate come from the estate's shared sourced basis, vendored byte for byte at vendor/sovereign-enterprise/basis.json. None of it is a price for the BES layer, which is MIT-licensed with no licence fee.

sources.what: Microsoft Entra ID P2 — everything in P1 plus Microsoft Entra ID Protection and risk-based Conditional Access: US$10.00 user/month, paid yearly (annual subscription, auto-renews). Counted once for each person who holds a key.

Microsoft Entra Workload ID — 'Manage workload identities to secure app and service access to cloud resources': US$3.00 user/month, paid yearly, as printed. Counted once for each AI agent on its own key.

Intel Core i7-1255U, the laptop chip this was built and measured on: Maximum Turbo Power 55 W (Processor Base Power 15 W). The case uses the most the chip can draw, so it never understates the electricity.
